                                        // Core render that we can call now and every minute
                                        function recalcAndRender(){
                                            var bundle = todayBundle();
                                            if(!bundle || bundle.indexOf('-')===-1) return;
                                            var openHHMM  = (bundle.split('-')[0]||'').trim();
                                            var closeHHMM = (bundle.split('-')[1]||'').trim();

                                            var now=nowMinInTZ(), o=parseHHMM(openHHMM), c=parseHHMM(closeHHMM);
                                            if(now==null||o==null||c==null) return;

                                            var isOpen = (now>=o && now<=c);

                                            if (isOpen) {
                                                status.textContent = i18n.open;
                                                if (img.src.indexOf('header_ellipse_green.svg')===-1) img.src = green;
                                                img.alt = "green dot";
                                            } else {
                                                var wait = minutesUntil(openHHMM);

                                                function unit(n, one, other){ return (n === 1) ? one : other; }

                                                var parts = [];
                                                if (wait.h > 0) parts.push(wait.h + ' ' + unit(wait.h, i18n.hour_one, i18n.hour_other));
                                                if (wait.m > 0 || parts.length === 0) parts.push(wait.m + ' ' + unit(wait.m, i18n.min_one, i18n.min_other));

                                                var hm = parts.join(' ');
                                                status.textContent = i18n.opening_in.replace(/%(\d+\$)?s/g, hm);

                                                status.textContent = i18n.opening_in.replace(/%(\d+\$)?s/g, hm);
                                                if (img.src.indexOf('header_ellipse_red.svg')===-1) img.src = red;
                                                img.alt = "red dot";
                                            }
                                        }

                                        recalcAndRender();

                                        (function schedule(){
                                            var P = partsInTZ();
                                            var msToNext = (60 - P.ss) * 1000;
                                            setTimeout(function tick(){
                                                recalcAndRender();
                                                setTimeout(tick, 60000); // every minute
                                            }, Math.max(200, msToNext));
                                        })();
                                    }catch(e){}
                                })();
                            </script>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="h-serveriai-lt-paslaugos-persikele-i-interneto-vizija"><strong>Serveriai.lt paslaugos persikėlė į Interneto viziją</strong></h2>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Serveriai.lt buvo vienas iš UAB „Interneto vizija“ projektų, skirtas paprastiems ir neribotiems svetainių talpinimo planams.</p>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Per laiką išaugome – išplėtėme paslaugas, planus ir sprendimus skirtingiems poreikiams.<br>Šiandien visas serveriai.lt paslaugas rasite pagrindinėje Interneto vizijos svetainėje, tik aiškiau suskirstytas pagal tai, ko iš tikrųjų reikia jūsų svetainei.</p>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Žemiau pasirinkite, kas jums aktualiausia.</p>



<div style="height:30px;"></div>



<div class="wp-block-media-text is-stacked-on-mobile is-vertically-aligned-center" style="grid-template-columns:15% auto"><figure class="wp-block-media-text__media"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="135" height="135" src="https://www.iv.lt/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Svetainiu_talpinimas.svg" alt="" class="wp-image-19123 size-full"/></figure><div class="wp-block-media-text__content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>WordPress hostingas</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Tinka jeigu kuriate WordPress svetainę, el. parduotuvę ar tinklaraštį ir norite, kad viskas veiktų greitai be papildomų konfigūracijų.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Optimizuota būtent WordPress sistemai, paruošta naudoti iš karto.</p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-1 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px"><a href="https://www.iv.lt/wordpress-hostingas/">Sužinoti daugiau ></a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div>



<div style="height:20px;"></div>



<div class="wp-block-media-text is-stacked-on-mobile is-vertically-aligned-center" style="grid-template-columns:15% auto"><figure class="wp-block-media-text__media"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="135" height="135" src="https://www.iv.lt/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Planas_pastui.svg" alt="" class="wp-image-18901 size-full"/></figure><div class="wp-block-media-text__content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>Svetainių talpinimas ir el. paštas</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Svetainių talpinimo planai tinka tiek paprastoms svetainėms ir el. paštui, tiek augantiems projektams, kuriems reikia daugiau laisvės.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Galite rinktis planus <strong>su ribotais resursais</strong>, kai aiškiai žinote savo poreikius, arba <strong>su neribotais resursais</strong>, kai nenorite skaičiuoti vietos, srauto ir el. pašto dėžučių.</p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-2 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px"><a href="http://www.iv.lt/talpinimo-planai">Sužinoti daugiau > </a></p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-3 wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div>



<div style="height:20px;"></div>



<div class="wp-block-media-text is-stacked-on-mobile is-vertically-aligned-center" style="grid-template-columns:15% auto"><figure class="wp-block-media-text__media"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="135" height="135" src="https://www.iv.lt/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Profesonalus_talpinimas.svg" alt="" class="wp-image-19137 size-full"/></figure><div class="wp-block-media-text__content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>Prohostingo paslaugos</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Ši paslauga skirta projektams, kuriems reikia ypatingo patikimumo, lankstumo ir didelių serverio resursų.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Kai įprasto hostingo ar VPS nepakanka, o nuosavo serverio priežiūra reikalauja per daug laiko, prohostingas leidžia tai patikėti profesionalams. 24/7 pasirūpiname infrastruktūra, saugumu ir serverio priežiūra, kad jūs galėtumėte susitelkti į savo projektą.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Tai sprendimas didesniems, augantiems ar verslo kritiniams projektams, kuriems svarbus maksimalus patikimumas ir profesionali serverio priežiūra.</p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-4 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px"><a href="https://www.iv.lt/profesionalus-hostingas/">Sužinoti daugiau > </a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div>



<div style="height:20px;"></div>



<div class="wp-block-media-text is-stacked-on-mobile is-vertically-aligned-center" style="grid-template-columns:15% auto"><figure class="wp-block-media-text__media"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="135" height="135" src="https://www.iv.lt/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Serveriu_spintos.svg" alt="" class="wp-image-19125 size-full"/></figure><div class="wp-block-media-text__content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>VPS serveriai</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">VPS serveriai skirti projektams, kuriems įprasto hostingo nepakanka ir reikia daugiau galios, lankstumo bei kontrolės. Tai sprendimas tiems, kuriems reikia ne tik talpinti svetainę, bet ir turėti pilnai valdomą serverio aplinką.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Tai virtualūs serveriai su atskirais resursais – procesoriumi, RAM atmintimi, vieta diske ir IP adresu. Galite patys pasirinkti operacinę sistemą, konfigūraciją ir diegti reikalingas sistemas ar programas pagal savo poreikius.</p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-5 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px"><a href="https://www.iv.lt/vps-serveriai/#linux">Sužinoti daugiau > </a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div>

                    // ===================

                    const INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

                    let intercomLoaded = false;
                    let intercomBooted = false;

                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` +

                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function deleteCookie(name) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=` +
                            `; Max-Age=0` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function clearIntercomCookies() {
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-id-${APP_ID}`);
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-session-${APP_ID}`);
                    }

                    if (!getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE)) {
                        clearIntercomCookies();
                    }

                    function generateId() {
                        return (crypto.randomUUID
                                ? crypto.randomUUID()
                                : "iv_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36)
                        );
                    }

                    function getOrCreateGuestId() {
                        const existing = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        if (existing) return existing;

                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        const id = generateId();
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, id, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);
                        return id;
                    }

                    function shutdownForPrivacy() {
                        if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                            try { window.Intercom("shutdown"); } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        deleteCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        intercomLoaded = false;
                        intercomBooted = false;
                    }

                    function resetIdleTimer(guestId) {
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, guestId, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);

                        if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
                        idleTimer = setTimeout(shutdownForPrivacy, INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS);
                    }

                    function isRealUserEvent(e) {
                        if (e && e.isTrusted === false) return false;
                        if (performance.now() - startedAt < 1500) return false;
                        return true;
                    }

                    function getParam(param) {
                        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                        return urlParams.get(param);

                        if (window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected) return;
                        window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected = true;

                        const d = document;
                        const s = d.createElement("script");

                        s.setAttribute("data-no-optimize", "1");
                        (d.head || d.body).appendChild(s);
                    }

                    function loadIntercomForRealUser(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;

                        if (intercomLoaded && intercomBooted) {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            return;
                        }

                        intercomLoaded = true;

                        const guestUserId = getOrCreateGuestId();

                        window.intercomSettings = {
                            api_base: "https://api-iam.eu.intercom.io",
                            app_id: APP_ID,
                            brand: "Interneto vizija",
                            language_override: "lt",

                            user_id: guestUserId,

                            session_duration: INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS
                        };

                        if (typeof window.Intercom !== "function") {

                            i.q = [];
                            i.c = function (args) { i.q.push(args); };
                            window.Intercom = i;
                        }

                        ensureIntercomScriptLoaded();

                        if (!intercomBooted) {
                            window.Intercom("boot", window.intercomSettings);
                            intercomBooted = true;
                        } else {
                            window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                        }

                        resetIdleTimer(guestUserId);

                        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
                            if (!document.hidden) {
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                    window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                                }
                                resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }
                        });

                        window.addEventListener("focus", () => {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                            }
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                        });

                        ["pointerdown", "keydown", "click", "scroll", "touchstart", "mousemove"].forEach(evtName => {
                            window.addEventListener(evtName, (evt) => {
                                if (!isRealUserEvent(evt)) return;
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                                if (gid) resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }, { passive: true });
                        });

                        if (getParam("openChat") === "true") {
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") window.Intercom("show");
                            }, 800);
                        }
                    }

                    function onScroll(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((window.scrollY || 0) < 120) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((Math.abs(e.movementX) + Math.abs(e.movementY)) < 8) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("keydown", loadIntercomForRealUser);
                    window.addEventListener("touchstart", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
                }

                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` +

                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function deleteCookie(name) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=` +
                            `; Max-Age=0` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function clearIntercomCookies() {
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-id-${APP_ID}`);
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-session-${APP_ID}`);
                    }

                    if (!getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE)) {
                        clearIntercomCookies();
                    }

                    function generateId() {
                        return (crypto.randomUUID
                                ? crypto.randomUUID()
                                : "iv_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36)
                        );
                    }

                    function getOrCreateGuestId() {
                        const existing = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        if (existing) return existing;

                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        const id = generateId();
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, id, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);
                        return id;
                    }

                    function shutdownForPrivacy() {
                        if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {

                        }
                        deleteCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        intercomLoaded = false;
                        intercomBooted = false;
                    }

                    function resetIdleTimer(guestId) {
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, guestId, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);

                        if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
                        idleTimer = setTimeout(shutdownForPrivacy, INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS);
                    }

                    function isRealUserEvent(e) {
                        if (e && e.isTrusted === false) return false;
                        if (performance.now() - startedAt < 1500) return false;
                        return true;
                    }

                    function getParam(param) {
                        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

                        window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected = true;

                        const d = document;

                        s.setAttribute("data-no-optimize", "1");
                        (d.head || d.body).appendChild(s);
                    }

                    function loadIntercomForRealUser(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;

                        if (intercomLoaded && intercomBooted) {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            return;

                        intercomLoaded = true;

                        window.intercomSettings = {

                            app_id: APP_ID,
                            brand: "Interneto vizija",
                            language_override: "lt",

                        };

                            i.q = [];
                            i.c = function (args) { i.q.push(args); };
                            window.Intercom = i;
                        }

                        ensureIntercomScriptLoaded();

                        if (!intercomBooted) {
                            window.Intercom("boot", window.intercomSettings);
                            intercomBooted = true;
                        } else {
                            window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                        }

                        resetIdleTimer(guestUserId);

                        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
                            if (!document.hidden) {
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                    window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                                }
                                resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }
                        });

                        window.addEventListener("focus", () => {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                            }
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                        });

                        ["pointerdown", "keydown", "click", "scroll", "touchstart", "mousemove"].forEach(evtName => {
                            window.addEventListener(evtName, (evt) => {
                                if (!isRealUserEvent(evt)) return;
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                                if (gid) resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }, { passive: true });
                        });

                        if (getParam("openChat") === "true") {
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") window.Intercom("show");
                            }, 800);
                        }
                    }

                    function onScroll(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((window.scrollY || 0) < 120) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    function onMouseMove(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((Math.abs(e.movementX) + Math.abs(e.movementY)) < 8) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("keydown", loadIntercomForRealUser);
                    window.addEventListener("touchstart", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
                }

                                        var i18n = {"open":"Dirbame!","opening_in":"Dirbsime po %s","hour_one":"valandos","hour_other":"valand\u0173","min_one":"minut\u0117s","min_other":"minu\u010di\u0173","and":"ir"};

                                        function parseHHMM(s){ if(!s||s.indexOf(':')===-1)return null; var p=s.split(':'), h=+p[0], m=+p[1]; return (isNaN(h)||isNaN(m))?null:h*60+m; }

<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>Svetainių talpinimas ir el. paštas</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Svetainių talpinimo planai tinka tiek paprastoms svetainėms ir el. paštui, tiek augantiems projektams, kuriems reikia daugiau laisvės.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Galite rinktis planus <strong>su ribotais resursais</strong>, kai aiškiai žinote savo poreikius, arba <strong>su neribotais resursais</strong>, kai nenorite skaičiuoti vietos, srauto ir el. pašto dėžučių.</p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-2 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px"><a href="http://www.iv.lt/talpinimo-planai">Sužinoti daugiau > </a></p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>Prohostingo paslaugos</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Ši paslauga skirta projektams, kuriems reikia ypatingo patikimumo, lankstumo ir didelių serverio resursų.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Kai įprasto hostingo ar VPS nepakanka, o nuosavo serverio priežiūra reikalauja per daug laiko, prohostingas leidžia tai patikėti profesionalams. 24/7 pasirūpiname infrastruktūra, saugumu ir serverio priežiūra, kad jūs galėtumėte susitelkti į savo projektą.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Tai sprendimas didesniems, augantiems ar verslo kritiniams projektams, kuriems svarbus maksimalus patikimumas ir profesionali serverio priežiūra.</p>



<p class="has-green-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-4 wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px"><a href="https://www.iv.lt/profesionalus-hostingas/">Sužinoti daugiau > </a></p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>VPS serveriai</strong></p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Tai virtualūs serveriai su atskirais resursais – procesoriumi, RAM atmintimi, vieta diske ir IP adresu. Galite patys pasirinkti operacinę sistemą, konfigūraciją ir diegti reikalingas sistemas ar programas pagal savo poreikius.</p>

                async function checkStatus() {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch('https://paslaugos.iv.lt/intercom.php?type=intercom_chat_lt');
                        const text = await response.text();

                function showIntercom() {
                    // ===================
                    // CONFIG (GUEST MODE)
                    // ===================
                    const APP_ID = "vwhwt4d6";
                    const COOKIE_DOMAIN = ".iv.lt"; // <-- CHANGE THIS (share across root + subdomain)
                    const GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES = 15;

                    const GUEST_UID_COOKIE = "iv_intercom_uid";
                    const GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60;
                    const INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

                    let intercomLoaded = false;
                    let intercomBooted = false;
                    let idleTimer = null;

                    const startedAt = performance.now();

                    function getCookie(name) {
                        const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp("(?:^|; )" + name + "=([^;]*)"));
                        return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
                    }

                    function setCookie(name, value, maxAgeSeconds) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` +
                            `; Max-Age=${maxAgeSeconds}` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function deleteCookie(name) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=` +
                            `; Max-Age=0` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function clearIntercomCookies() {
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-id-${APP_ID}`);
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-session-${APP_ID}`);
                    }

                    if (!getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE)) {
                        clearIntercomCookies();
                    }

                    function generateId() {
                        return (crypto.randomUUID
                                ? crypto.randomUUID()
                                : "iv_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36)
                        );
                    }

                    function getOrCreateGuestId() {
                        const existing = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        if (existing) return existing;

                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        const id = generateId();
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, id, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);
                        return id;
                    }

                    function shutdownForPrivacy() {
                        if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                            try { window.Intercom("shutdown"); } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        deleteCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        intercomLoaded = false;
                        intercomBooted = false;
                    }

                    function resetIdleTimer(guestId) {
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, guestId, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);

                        if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
                        idleTimer = setTimeout(shutdownForPrivacy, INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS);
                    }

                    function isRealUserEvent(e) {
                        if (e && e.isTrusted === false) return false;
                        if (performance.now() - startedAt < 1500) return false;
                        return true;
                    }

                    function getParam(param) {
                        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                        return urlParams.get(param);
                    }

                    function ensureIntercomScriptLoaded() {
                        if (window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected) return;
                        window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected = true;

                        const d = document;
                        const s = d.createElement("script");
                        s.type = "text/javascript";
                        s.async = true;
                        s.src = "https://widget.intercom.io/widget/" + APP_ID;
                        s.setAttribute("data-no-optimize", "1");
                        (d.head || d.body).appendChild(s);
                    }

                    function loadIntercomForRealUser(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;

                        if (intercomLoaded && intercomBooted) {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            return;
                        }

                        intercomLoaded = true;

                        const guestUserId = getOrCreateGuestId();

                        window.intercomSettings = {
                            api_base: "https://api-iam.eu.intercom.io",
                            app_id: APP_ID,
                            brand: "Interneto vizija",
                            language_override: "lt",

                            user_id: guestUserId,

                            session_duration: INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS
                        };

                        if (typeof window.Intercom !== "function") {
                            const i = function () { i.c(arguments); };
                            i.q = [];
                            i.c = function (args) { i.q.push(args); };
                            window.Intercom = i;
                        }

                        ensureIntercomScriptLoaded();

                        if (!intercomBooted) {
                            window.Intercom("boot", window.intercomSettings);
                            intercomBooted = true;
                        } else {
                            window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                        }

                        resetIdleTimer(guestUserId);

                        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
                            if (!document.hidden) {
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                    window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                                }
                                resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }
                        });

                        window.addEventListener("focus", () => {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                            }
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                        });

                        ["pointerdown", "keydown", "click", "scroll", "touchstart", "mousemove"].forEach(evtName => {
                            window.addEventListener(evtName, (evt) => {
                                if (!isRealUserEvent(evt)) return;
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                                if (gid) resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }, { passive: true });
                        });

                        if (getParam("openChat") === "true") {
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") window.Intercom("show");
                            }, 800);
                        }
                    }

                    function onScroll(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((window.scrollY || 0) < 120) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    function onMouseMove(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((Math.abs(e.movementX) + Math.abs(e.movementY)) < 8) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("keydown", loadIntercomForRealUser);
                    window.addEventListener("touchstart", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
                }

                                        function parseHHMM(s){ if(!s||s.indexOf(':')===-1)return null; var p=s.split(':'), h=+p[0], m=+p[1]; return (isNaN(h)||isNaN(m))?null:h*60+m; }

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="h-serveriai-lt-paslaugos-persikele-i-interneto-vizija"><strong>Serveriai.lt paslaugos persikėlė į Interneto viziją</strong></h2>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Serveriai.lt buvo vienas iš UAB „Interneto vizija“ projektų, skirtas paprastiems ir neribotiems svetainių talpinimo planams.</p>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Per laiką išaugome – išplėtėme paslaugas, planus ir sprendimus skirtingiems poreikiams.<br>Šiandien visas serveriai.lt paslaugas rasite pagrindinėje Interneto vizijos svetainėje, tik aiškiau suskirstytas pagal tai, ko iš tikrųjų reikia jūsų svetainei.</p>



<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:19px">Žemiau pasirinkite, kas jums aktualiausia.</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph" style="font-size:25px"><strong>Prohostingo paslaugos</strong></p>

                            `; Path=/` +

                            <script>
                                (function(){
                                    try{

                                        var tz      = "Europe\/Vilnius";
                                        var monfri  = "08:00-19:00";
                                        var satsun  = "10:00-19:00";
                                        var i18n = {"open":"Dirbame!","opening_in":"Dirbsime po %s","hour_one":"valandos","hour_other":"valand\u0173","min_one":"minut\u0117s","min_other":"minu\u010di\u0173","and":"ir"};
                                        var green   = "https:\/\/www.iv.lt\/wp-content\/plugins\/custom-header-info\/images\/header_ellipse_green.svg";
                                        var red     = "https:\/\/www.iv.lt\/wp-content\/plugins\/custom-header-info\/images\/header_ellipse_red.svg";

                                        function parseHHMM(s){ if(!s||s.indexOf(':')===-1)return null; var p=s.split(':'), h=+p[0], m=+p[1]; return (isNaN(h)||isNaN(m))?null:h*60+m; }
                                        function partsInTZ(){
                                            var prts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit',hour12:false,timeZone:tz}).formatToParts(new Date()),
                                                o={}; for(var i=0;i<prts.length;i++) o[prts[i].type]=prts[i].value;
                                            return {y:+o.year,m:(+o.month)-1,d:+o.day,hh:+o.hour,mm:+o.minute,ss:+o.second, ms:0};
                                        }
                                        function weekdayInTZ(){ return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{weekday:'long',timeZone:tz}).format(new Date()).toLowerCase(); }
                                        function nowMinInTZ(){
                                            var f=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false,timeZone:tz}).format(new Date()).split(':');
                                            return (+f[0])*60+(+f[1]);
                                        }
                                        function minutesUntil(nextHHMM){
                                            var P=partsInTZ(), nowUTC=new Date(Date.UTC(P.y,P.m,P.d,P.hh,P.mm,P.ss));
                                            var hh=+nextHHMM.split(':')[0], mm=+nextHHMM.split(':')[1];
                                            var tgt=new Date(Date.UTC(P.y,P.m,P.d,hh,mm,0)), diff=tgt-nowUTC;
                                            if(diff<0) diff=new Date(Date.UTC(P.y,P.m,P.d+1,hh,mm,0))-nowUTC;
                                            var mins=Math.max(0,Math.round(diff/60000));
                                            return {h:Math.floor(mins/60), m:mins%60};
                                        }

                                        function todayBundle(){

                                        // Core render that we can call now and every minute
                                        function recalcAndRender(){
                                            var bundle = todayBundle();
                                            if(!bundle || bundle.indexOf('-')===-1) return;
                                            var openHHMM  = (bundle.split('-')[0]||'').trim();
                                            var closeHHMM = (bundle.split('-')[1]||'').trim();

                                            var now=nowMinInTZ(), o=parseHHMM(openHHMM), c=parseHHMM(closeHHMM);
                                            if(now==null||o==null||c==null) return;

                                            var isOpen = (now>=o && now<=c);

                                            if (isOpen) {
                                                status.textContent = i18n.open;

                                                var hm = parts.join(' ');
                                                status.textContent = i18n.opening_in.replace(/%(\d+\$)?s/g, hm);

                                                status.textContent = i18n.opening_in.replace(/%(\d+\$)?s/g, hm);
                                                if (img.src.indexOf('header_ellipse_red.svg')===-1) img.src = red;
                                                img.alt = "red dot";
                                            }
                                        }

                                        recalcAndRender();

                                        (function schedule(){
                                            var P = partsInTZ();
                                            var msToNext = (60 - P.ss) * 1000;
                                            setTimeout(function tick(){

                                                setTimeout(tick, 60000); // every minute

                                        })();

                async function checkStatus() {

                        const text = await response.text();

                function showIntercom() {
                    // ===================
                    // CONFIG (GUEST MODE)
                    // ===================
                    const APP_ID = "vwhwt4d6";
                    const COOKIE_DOMAIN = ".iv.lt"; // <-- CHANGE THIS (share across root + subdomain)
                    const GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES = 15;

                    const GUEST_UID_COOKIE = "iv_intercom_uid";
                    const GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60;
                    const INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

                    let intercomLoaded = false;
                    let intercomBooted = false;
                    let idleTimer = null;

                    const startedAt = performance.now();

                    function getCookie(name) {
                        const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp("(?:^|; )" + name + "=([^;]*)"));
                        return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
                    }

                    function setCookie(name, value, maxAgeSeconds) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` +
                            `; Max-Age=${maxAgeSeconds}` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function deleteCookie(name) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=` +
                            `; Max-Age=0` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function clearIntercomCookies() {
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-id-${APP_ID}`);
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-session-${APP_ID}`);
                    }

                    if (!getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE)) {
                        clearIntercomCookies();
                    }

                    function generateId() {
                        return (crypto.randomUUID
                                ? crypto.randomUUID()
                                : "iv_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36)
                        );
                    }

                    function getOrCreateGuestId() {
                        const existing = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        if (existing) return existing;

                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        const id = generateId();
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, id, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);
                        return id;
                    }

                    function shutdownForPrivacy() {
                        if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                            try { window.Intercom("shutdown"); } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        deleteCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        intercomLoaded = false;
                        intercomBooted = false;
                    }

                    function resetIdleTimer(guestId) {
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, guestId, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);

                        if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
                        idleTimer = setTimeout(shutdownForPrivacy, INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS);
                    }

                    function isRealUserEvent(e) {
                        if (e && e.isTrusted === false) return false;
                        if (performance.now() - startedAt < 1500) return false;
                        return true;
                    }

                    function getParam(param) {
                        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                        return urlParams.get(param);
                    }

                    function ensureIntercomScriptLoaded() {
                        if (window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected) return;
                        window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected = true;

                        const d = document;
                        const s = d.createElement("script");
                        s.type = "text/javascript";
                        s.async = true;
                        s.src = "https://widget.intercom.io/widget/" + APP_ID;
                        s.setAttribute("data-no-optimize", "1");
                        (d.head || d.body).appendChild(s);
                    }

                    function loadIntercomForRealUser(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;

                        if (intercomLoaded && intercomBooted) {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            return;
                        }

                        intercomLoaded = true;

                        const guestUserId = getOrCreateGuestId();

                        window.intercomSettings = {
                            api_base: "https://api-iam.eu.intercom.io",
                            app_id: APP_ID,
                            brand: "Interneto vizija",
                            language_override: "lt",

                            user_id: guestUserId,

                            session_duration: INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS
                        };

                        if (typeof window.Intercom !== "function") {
                            const i = function () { i.c(arguments); };
                            i.q = [];
                            i.c = function (args) { i.q.push(args); };
                            window.Intercom = i;
                        }

                        ensureIntercomScriptLoaded();

                        if (!intercomBooted) {
                            window.Intercom("boot", window.intercomSettings);
                            intercomBooted = true;
                        } else {
                            window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                        }

                        resetIdleTimer(guestUserId);

                        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
                            if (!document.hidden) {
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                    window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                                }
                                resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }
                        });

                        window.addEventListener("focus", () => {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                            }
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                        });

                        ["pointerdown", "keydown", "click", "scroll", "touchstart", "mousemove"].forEach(evtName => {
                            window.addEventListener(evtName, (evt) => {
                                if (!isRealUserEvent(evt)) return;
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                                if (gid) resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }, { passive: true });
                        });

                        if (getParam("openChat") === "true") {
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") window.Intercom("show");
                            }, 800);
                        }
                    }

                    function onScroll(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((window.scrollY || 0) < 120) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    function onMouseMove(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((Math.abs(e.movementX) + Math.abs(e.movementY)) < 8) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("keydown", loadIntercomForRealUser);
                    window.addEventListener("touchstart", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
                }

            <script>
                async function checkStatus() {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch('https://paslaugos.iv.lt/intercom.php?type=intercom_chat_lt');
                        const text = await response.text();
                        const result = JSON.parse(text);
                        let status = result.status === 'yes';

                            showIntercom();
                        }
                    } catch (error) {

                }

                checkStatus();

                function showIntercom() {
                    // ===================
                    // CONFIG (GUEST MODE)
                    // ===================
                    const APP_ID = "vwhwt4d6";
                    const COOKIE_DOMAIN = ".iv.lt"; // <-- CHANGE THIS (share across root + subdomain)
                    const GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES = 15;

                    const GUEST_UID_COOKIE = "iv_intercom_uid";
                    const GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60;
                    const INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS = GUEST_SESSION_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

                    let intercomLoaded = false;
                    let intercomBooted = false;
                    let idleTimer = null;

                    const startedAt = performance.now();

                    function getCookie(name) {
                        const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp("(?:^|; )" + name + "=([^;]*)"));
                        return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
                    }

                    function setCookie(name, value, maxAgeSeconds) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` +
                            `; Max-Age=${maxAgeSeconds}` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function deleteCookie(name) {
                        const secure = location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";
                        document.cookie =
                            `${name}=` +
                            `; Max-Age=0` +
                            `; Path=/` +
                            `; Domain=${COOKIE_DOMAIN}` +
                            `; SameSite=Lax` +
                            secure;
                    }

                    function clearIntercomCookies() {
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-id-${APP_ID}`);
                        deleteCookie(`intercom-session-${APP_ID}`);
                    }

                    if (!getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE)) {
                        clearIntercomCookies();
                    }

                    function generateId() {
                        return (crypto.randomUUID
                                ? crypto.randomUUID()
                                : "iv_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36)
                        );
                    }

                    function getOrCreateGuestId() {
                        const existing = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        if (existing) return existing;

                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        const id = generateId();
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, id, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);
                        return id;
                    }

                    function shutdownForPrivacy() {
                        if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                            try { window.Intercom("shutdown"); } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        deleteCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                        clearIntercomCookies();

                        intercomLoaded = false;
                        intercomBooted = false;
                    }

                    function resetIdleTimer(guestId) {
                        setCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE, guestId, GUEST_UID_MAX_AGE_SECONDS);

                        if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
                        idleTimer = setTimeout(shutdownForPrivacy, INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS);
                    }

                    function isRealUserEvent(e) {
                        if (e && e.isTrusted === false) return false;
                        if (performance.now() - startedAt < 1500) return false;
                        return true;
                    }

                    function getParam(param) {
                        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
                        return urlParams.get(param);
                    }

                    function ensureIntercomScriptLoaded() {
                        if (window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected) return;
                        window.__ivIntercomScriptInjected = true;

                        const d = document;
                        const s = d.createElement("script");
                        s.type = "text/javascript";
                        s.async = true;
                        s.src = "https://widget.intercom.io/widget/" + APP_ID;
                        s.setAttribute("data-no-optimize", "1");
                        (d.head || d.body).appendChild(s);
                    }

                    function loadIntercomForRealUser(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;

                        if (intercomLoaded && intercomBooted) {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            return;
                        }

                        intercomLoaded = true;

                        const guestUserId = getOrCreateGuestId();

                        window.intercomSettings = {
                            api_base: "https://api-iam.eu.intercom.io",
                            app_id: APP_ID,
                            brand: "Interneto vizija",
                            language_override: "lt",

                            user_id: guestUserId,

                            session_duration: INTERCOM_SESSION_DURATION_MS
                        };

                        if (typeof window.Intercom !== "function") {
                            const i = function () { i.c(arguments); };
                            i.q = [];
                            i.c = function (args) { i.q.push(args); };
                            window.Intercom = i;
                        }

                        ensureIntercomScriptLoaded();

                        if (!intercomBooted) {
                            window.Intercom("boot", window.intercomSettings);
                            intercomBooted = true;
                        } else {
                            window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                        }

                        resetIdleTimer(guestUserId);

                        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
                            if (!document.hidden) {
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                    window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                                }
                                resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }
                        });

                        window.addEventListener("focus", () => {
                            const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE) || getOrCreateGuestId();
                            if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") {
                                window.Intercom("update", window.intercomSettings);
                            }
                            resetIdleTimer(gid);
                        });

                        ["pointerdown", "keydown", "click", "scroll", "touchstart", "mousemove"].forEach(evtName => {
                            window.addEventListener(evtName, (evt) => {
                                if (!isRealUserEvent(evt)) return;
                                const gid = getCookie(GUEST_UID_COOKIE);
                                if (gid) resetIdleTimer(gid);
                            }, { passive: true });
                        });

                        if (getParam("openChat") === "true") {
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                if (typeof window.Intercom === "function") window.Intercom("show");
                            }, 800);
                        }
                    }

                    function onScroll(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((window.scrollY || 0) < 120) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    function onMouseMove(e) {
                        if (!isRealUserEvent(e)) return;
                        if ((Math.abs(e.movementX) + Math.abs(e.movementY)) < 8) return;
                        loadIntercomForRealUser(e);
                    }

                    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("keydown", loadIntercomForRealUser);
                    window.addEventListener("touchstart", loadIntercomForRealUser, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove, { passive: true });
                    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
                }
